enumPropertyVisibility.description: If the visibility is 'idealista', you can find the property using the idealista's search engine; 'microsite', the property is only published on the real estate agency microsite; 'private', the property is not published and only the customer can see it.

virtualTour3DType.title: virtual tour 3D type
virtualTour3DType.description: Deprecated. It will be automatically calculated from the url if it belongs to one of the virtual tours 3D supported by idealista

virtualTourType.title: virtual tour type
virtualTourType.description: Deprecated. It will be automatically calculated from the url if it belongs to one of the virtual tours supported by idealista

descriptionText.title: description text

line breaks are allowed using '
' (wihout the quotes)

propertyCode.title: New Development identifier
propertyCode.description: It must be unique for each property and unchanging over time

propertyForSale.title: promo for sale
propertyForSale.description: indicates the operation of the promo as sale when no typologies are sent. If there are typologies under the promo those will define the operation.

propertyForRent.title: promo for rent
propertyForRent.description: indicates the operation of the promo as rent when no typologies are sent. If there are typologies under the promo those will define the operation.

propertyForRentToOwn.title: promo for rent to own
propertyForRentToOwn.description: indicates the operation of the promo as rent to own when no typologies are sent. If there are typologies under the promo those will define the operation.

propertyCode.title: Property identifier
propertyCode.description: It must be unique for each property and unchanging over time. This code will be the internal id to match it with our id. Its not the same that the propertyReference value. If the code changes, the property that was associated with this code will be unset on our systems

casaPropertyCode.title: Property identifier in Casa.it
casaPropertyCode.description: The code you are already sending to Casa.it as listingid, as unique identifier

propertyReference.title: Property reference
propertyReference.description: Internal reference of the property in the customer system. It's not necessary for this reference to be unique

featuresType.title: property types
featuresType.description: office_coworking not allowed for sale operation

featuresAdditionalRentCharges.title: additional rent charges
featuresAdditionalRentCharges.description: Only allowed for France. Optional, only allowed if featuresRentControl is true

featuresOfficeAreaConstructed.title: Constructed Area
featuresOfficeAreaConstructed.description: built square meters. When office type is 'coworking', this value must be between 1 and 15 m².

featuresBathroomAdapted.title: adapted bathroom
featuresBathroomAdapted.description: availability of adapted bathroom for disabled people

featuresBathroomInside.title: bathroom inside
featuresBathroomInside.description: bathroom inside the property is available

featuresBedroomNumber.title: bedrooms number
featuresBedroomNumber.description: In France, only allowed if featuresStudio is false and featuresRooms is greater than 1

featuresClassificationAgricultural.title: agricultural classification
featuresClassificationAgricultural.description: Only allowed for France. Only allowed for land with type land_countrynonbuildable

featuresClassificationIsland.title: island classification
featuresClassificationIsland.description: Only allowed for France. Only allowed for land with type land_countrynonbuildable

featuresClassificationLeisure.title: leisure classification
featuresClassificationLeisure.description: Only allowed for France. Only allowed for land with type land_countrynonbuildable

featuresConservation.title: conservation status
featuresConservation.description: status new is only available for new development properties, not for secondhand properties. fully_reformed only available for Italy, in idealista will be as good condition, it will be only used for Casa.it. new_development_in_construction and new_development_finished only available for Italy and France.

featuresDuplex.title: duplex
featuresDuplex.description: flat on two floors connected by an indoor staircase

featuresEnergyCertificateLaw.title: energy certification law
featuresEnergyCertificateLaw.description: only for Italy, indicates the legislation that applies to the energy rating, DL-192(2005) or LEGGE-90(2013)

featuresEnergyCertificateRating.title: energy certification rating
featuresEnergyCertificateRating.description: Allowed values for Spain: A,B,C,D,E,F,G,exempt. Values inProcess,unknown will be set to G for default. Allowed values for Italy: A+,A4,A3,A2,A1,A,B,C,D,E,F,G,exempt,inProcess,unknown. Allowed values for Portugal: A+,A,B,B-,C,D,E,F,G,exempt,inProcess,unknown. Allowed values for France: A,B,C,D,E,F,G,exempt,inProcess,unknown.

featuresEnergyCertificateType.title: energy certification type
featuresEnergyCertificateType.description: only available for new development properties. project: certification in project phase; completed: certification if the property is finished

featuresEnergyCertificateEmissionsRating.title: energy certification emissions rating
featuresEnergyCertificateEmissionsRating.description: Available for Spain and France. In France only A, B, C, D, E, F, G are allowed. Not mandatory if featuresEnergyCertificateRating is exempt

featuresEnergyCertificateEmissionsValue.title: energy certification emissions value
featuresEnergyCertificateEmissionsValue.description: only available for Spain. Only allowed if featuresEnergyCertificateEmissionsRating is present

featuresEnergyCertificateAdemeCode.title: energy certification ADEME code
featuresEnergyCertificateAdemeCode.description: Only allowed for France. Optional ADEME identifier code for the energy certificate

featuresEnergyCertificateDate.title: energy certification date
featuresEnergyCertificateDate.description: Only allowed for France. Mandatory unless featuresEnergyCertificateRating is exempt. Indicates if the DPE was issued before or after July 1st 2021

featuresEquippedKitchen.title: equipped with kitchen
featuresEquippedKitchen.description: equipped with kitchen only, this value is only available for rent operation

featuresEquippedWithFurniture.title: equipped with furniture
featuresEquippedWithFurniture.description: fully furnished, this value is only available for rent operation and will only be processed if featuresEquippedKitchen is true

featuresFee.title: agency fee
featuresFee.description: Only allowed for France. Agency fee amount. Mandatory when feePayerType is 'buyer_expenses' or 'shared_expenses'.

featuresFeePayerType.title: fee payer type
featuresFeePayerType.description: Only allowed for France. Indicates who pays the agency fee. For rent operation only seller_expenses is allowed

featuresFloorsInTop.title: floor in top
featuresFloorsInTop.description: flats: indicates if the property is on the last floor / houses: specific field for 'andar de moradia' property type, indicates if the property is the one on the upper floor (true) or the one in the lower floor (false)

featuresHandicapAdaptedAccess.title: handicap adapted access availability
featuresHandicapAdaptedAccess.description: access adapted to people with reduced mobility

featuresHandicapAdaptedUse.title: handicap adapted use availability
featuresHandicapAdaptedUse.description: property adapted to people with reduced mobility

featuresParkingType.title: parking types
featuresParkingType.description: this feature only applies for Portugal and Italy garages. 'depot' if is a box garage. 'parking_space' if is a regular garage

featuresRoomsSplitted.title: rooms splitted
featuresRoomsSplitted.description: Indicates if the rooms are splitted. If office_coworking is sent openPlan is mandatory

featuresServiceCharges.title: service charges
featuresServiceCharges.description: Only allowed for France, rent operation. Monthly service charges paid by the tenant (montant des charges)

featuresBareFree.title: bare free
featuresBareFree.description: Only allowed for France. Only allowed when featuresCurrentOccupation is life_estate. Indicates if the property is vacant

featuresBaseRent.title: base rent
featuresBaseRent.description: Only allowed for France. Mandatory if featuresRentControl is true. Monthly base rent excluding charges

featuresWcNumber.title: WC number
featuresWcNumber.description: Only allowed for France. Number of toilets

featuresWindowsLocation.title: windows location
featuresWindowsLocation.description: internal / external flat based on windows view. Only available for Spain.

enumFeaturesBuiltPhase.description: Phase of built for new developments

enumFeaturesAvailabilityHour.description: Booth sales availability hour for new developments

featuresSmokingAllowed.title: smoking allowed
featuresSmokingAllowed.description: Tells if smoking is allowed in the property

featuresMinTenantAge.title: min tenant age
featuresMinTenantAge.description: Age of the youngest tenant. This field is mandatory if featuresOccupiedNow = true, and is not allowed if featuresOccupiedNow = false

featuresMaxTenantAge.title: max tenant age
featuresMaxTenantAge.description: Age of the oldest tenant. This field is mandatory if featuresOccupiedNow = true, and is not allowed if featuresOccupiedNow = false

featuresCouplesAllowed.title: couples allowed
featuresCouplesAllowed.description: Tells if couples are allowed in the property

featuresMinimalStay.title: Minimal stay
featuresMinimalStay.description: Minimal stay in months for the new tenant

featuresMonthlyFee.title: monthly fee
featuresMonthlyFee.description: Only allowed for France. Monthly fee for life estate. Only allowed when featuresCurrentOccupation is life_estate

featuresOwnerLiving.title: owner living
featuresOwnerLiving.description: Tells if the owner of the property lives there. This field is mandatory if featuresOccupiedNow = true, and is not allowed if featuresOccupiedNow = false

featuresAvailableFrom.title: available from date
featuresAvailableFrom.description: Date when the room will be available. The format must be 'yyyy-mm' (year-month) and the range of values goes from the current month to the following 5 months

featuresTenantGender.title: tenant gender
featuresTenantGender.description: Gender of the tenants that currently lives in the property. This field is mandatory if featuresOccupiedNow = true, and is not allowed if featuresOccupiedNow = false

featuresLgtbFriendly.title: LGTB friendly
featuresLgtbFriendly.description: Indicates if the flat mates are comfortable sharing the property with a LGTB person

featuresOccupiedNow.title: occupied now
featuresOccupiedNow.description: Indicates if the property is currently occupied

featuresTenantWorkers.title: tenants workers
featuresTenantWorkers.description: It can only be sent if 'featuresOccupiedNow' is true. Indicates if there are workers in the property

featuresTenantStudents.title: tenants students
featuresTenantStudents.description: It can only be sent if 'featuresOccupiedNow' is true. Indicates if there are students in the property

featuresMinNewTenantAge.title: min age
featuresMinNewTenantAge.description: Minimum age limit for the new tenant. It must be sent together with featuresMaxTenantNewAge

featuresMaxNewTenantAge.title: min age
featuresMaxNewTenantAge.description: Maximum age limit for the new tenant. It must be sent together with featuresMinNewTenantAge

featuresMaxReferenceRent.title: max reference rent
featuresMaxReferenceRent.description: Only allowed for France. Mandatory if featuresRentControl is true. Maximum reference rent allowed (loyer de référence majoré)

featuresExteriorAccessibility.title: exterior accessibility
featuresExteriorAccessibility.description: Access of the property is adapted for people with reduced mobility

featuresInteriorAccessibility.title: exterior accessibility
featuresInteriorAccessibility.description: Property is adapted for people with reduced mobility

featuresPriceReferenceIndex.title: Price Reference Index
featuresPriceReferenceIndex.description: The reference index of rental prices is a compulsory public guidance figure from the Housing Agency of Catalonia (Spain) for the vast majority of its municipalities, indicating the price analysed according to the area and its specific characteristics

featuresAuction.title: is an auction
featuresAuction.description: Just available for Italy. Indicates if the property belongs to an auction. Auctions are only allowed for SALE operation.

featuresMinAuctionBidIncrement.title: minimal auction bid increment
featuresMinAuctionBidIncrement.description: Only allowed if featuresAuction is set to true. Minimal bid increment allowed for the auction

featuresAuctionDeposit.title: auction deposit
featuresAuctionDeposit.description: Only allowed if featuresAuction is set to true. Auction deposit percentage

featuresAuctionDate.title: auction date
featuresAuctionDate.description: Mandatory if featuresAuction is set to true. The date when the auction will take place. It must be greater than current date

featuresAuctionTribunal.title: auction tribunal
featuresAuctionTribunal.description: Only allowed  if featuresAuction is set to true.

featuresCurrentOccupation.title: occupation type of the property
featuresCurrentOccupation.description: In Spain and Portugal this field only allowed for flat, house and country house properties. Only allowed for sale operation. Indicates the occupation state of the property. "illegally_occupied" only allowed for Spain. "not_free" only allowed for Italy. "bare_ownership" only allowed for Spain and Italy. "life_estate" only allowed for France. In France only "free", "life_estate" and "tenanted" are allowed.

featuresGardenType.title: garden type
featuresGardenType.description: only available for Italy. featuresGarden must be true. Indicates the garden type of the property

featuresParkingSpaceCapacity.title: parking space type
featuresParkingSpaceCapacity.description: only available for Italy. featuresParkingAvailable must be true. Indicates the parking space type of the property

featuresParkingSpaceArea.title: buildable area
featuresParkingSpaceArea.description: only available for Italy.. featuresParkingAvailable must be true. Indicates the parking space area

featuresOutdoorParkingSpace.title: outdoor parking space available
featuresOutdoorParkingSpace.description: only available for Italy. Availability of outdoor parking space

featuresOutdoorParkingSpaceType.title: parking space type
featuresOutdoorParkingSpaceType.description: only available for Italy. featuresOutdoorParkingSpace must be true. Indicates the outdoor parking space type of the property

featuresOutdoorParkingSpaceNumber.title: outdoor parking space number
featuresOutdoorParkingSpaceNumber.description: only available for Italy. featuresOutdoorParkingSpace must be true. Indicates the number of parking spaces for the outdoor parking spaces

featuresHiddenPrice.title: hidden price
featuresHiddenPrice.description: only available for Italy. Trattativa riservata. Price must be sent. In idealista the property will not be shown, only available to edit in tools area. It will be sent to Casa.it only

featuresDocuments.title: new development documents
featuresDocuments.description: attached documents for new developments. Only one document per type allowed. Max size allowed is 40MB and the format must be pdf. If the property have a document uploaded manually, it won't be deleted and it will have to be handled manually

featuresRecommendedForChildren.title: recommended for children
featuresRecommendedForChildren.description: the house is suitable for children (0-12 years)

featuresRentControl.title: rent control
featuresRentControl.description: Only allowed for France, rent operation. Indicates if the property is subject to rent control (encadrement des loyers)

featuresResidential.title: residential
featuresResidential.description: Indicates if the property is for residential rental. Only for rent operation. Only one of the following values can be true: featuresSeasonalRental, featuresResidential or featuresShortTerm

featuresSeasonalRental.title: seasonal rental
featuresSeasonalRental.description: Indicates if the property is for seasonal rental. Only for rent operation. Only one of the following values can be true: featuresSeasonalRental, featuresResidential or featuresShortTerm

featuresShortTerm.title: short term
featuresShortTerm.description: Indicates if the property is for short term rental. Only for rent operation. Only one of the following values can be true: featuresSeasonalRental, featuresResidential or featuresShortTerm

featuresShortTermLicense.title: short term license
featuresShortTermLicense.description: Only available if featuresShortTerm = true. Mandatory for all countries. License for the short term property

featuresShortTermLicenseNational.title: short term license national
featuresShortTermLicenseNational.description: Only available if featuresShortTerm = true. Mandatory for Italy. National license for the short term property

featuresLowSeasonPrice.title: low season price
featuresLowSeasonPrice.description: Only available if shortTerm = true. Mandatory for Italy. Week price during the low season. Note that this field will only be shown if the property is also published in casa.it

featuresHighSeasonPrice.title: high season price
featuresHighSeasonPrice.description: Only available if shortTerm = true. Mandatory for Italy. Week price during the high season. Note that this field will only be shown if the property is also published in casa.it

featuresThirdPartiesRented.title: third parties rented
featuresThirdPartiesRented.description: Indicates if the property is rented to third parties

featuresRentedYieldPercentage.title: rented yield percentage
featuresRentedYieldPercentage.description: Only available if thirdPartiesRented is true. Yield percentage when the property is rented to third parties

featuresCommercialActivity.title: commercial activities
featuresCommercialActivity.description: Available commercial activities. If property is a transfer and this values is empty it will be set to other_commercial_activities

featuresIsATransfer.title: transfer commercial
featuresIsATransfer.description: Indicates if the commercial is a transfer. If priceTransfer is filled this field will be consider as true

featuresTransferEndContractDate.title: available from date
featuresTransferEndContractDate.description: Only available if operation=RENT, isAtransfer=true and priceTransfer filled. End date of the rental contract related to the commercial activity. The format must be 'yyyy-mm' (year-month)

featuresTriplex.title: triplex
featuresTriplex.description: Only allowed for France. Only for flat type homes. Flat on three floors connected by indoor staircases

featuresReferenceImages.title: transfer commercial
featuresReferenceImages.description: Only available if isAtransfer=true. Indicates if the commercial images are reference images.

featuresCouplesCosts.title: couples costs
featuresCouplesCosts.description: Only available if featuresCouplesAllowed is true.

residentOnly.title: resident only
residentOnly.description: Only allowed in some Italian areas, such as Trentino Alto Adige. Only allowed for residential and seasonal rental. Indicates if the property is only for residents

featuresSharedArea.title: shared area
featuresSharedArea.description: Indicates shared area of coworking offices. Only allowed for coworking offices

featuresOfficeAvailableFrom.title: available from date
featuresOfficeAvailableFrom.description: Date when the office will be available. The format must be 'yyyy-mm-dd'. Minimum value is today, maximum value is one year from today.

featuresLeedLevel.title: LEED certification level
featuresLeedLevel.description: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design certification level.

featuresBreeamLevel.title: BREEAM certification level
featuresBreeamLevel.description: Building Research Establishment Environmental Assessment Method certification level.

addressVisibility.title: address visibility
addressVisibility.description: full address, street name or zone will be shown publicly

addressFloor.title: address floor
addressFloor.description: bj: ground floor, en: mezzanine floor, ss: semi-basement, st: basement

addressUrbanization.title: address urbanization
addressUrbanization.description: note: this field will be shown even if the visibility is set to 'hidden'

addressNsiCode.title: address nsi code
addressNsiCode.description: national institute of statistics town code. Only available for Italy

addressCoordinatesPrecision.title: address coordinates precision
addressCoordinatesPrecision.description: if moved, just the property zone will be shown publicly, but not its address

addressCoordinatesLatitude.title: address coordinates latitude
addressCoordinatesLatitude.description: to have a good accuracy, latitude need to have at least 4 decimals

addressCoordinatesLongitude.title: address coordinates longitude
addressCoordinatesLongitude.description: to have a good accuracy, longitude need to have at least 4 decimals

addressCasaZoneId.title: address casa zone id
addressCasaZoneId.description: only available for Italy. It will be sent to Casa.it only to specify the zone

featuresCommercialMainActivity.title: Madatory if isATransfer is true. Main activity for commercial transfers

featuresCommercialSecondaryActivity.title: Secondary commercial activity for commercial transfers

operationPriceCommunity.title: community fees
operationPriceCommunity.description: for Spain and Portugal, this field only applies to sale properties

operationPriceToOwn.title: operation price to own
operationPriceToOwn.description: this operation only applies to new development properties. Not available for second hand properties

operationPriceTransfer.title: transfer price
operationPriceTransfer.description: Only available if isAtransfer=true. Price of the transfer

title: Videos Object
description: Formats allowed: AVI, MOV, WMV, MPEG, RM, MP4, FLV, M2T, 3GP. Max number of videos allowed: 6 per property. Max size of video allowed: 750MB

propertyCode.title: Property identifier
propertyCode.description: It must be unique for each property and unchanging over time

featuresType.description: Types availability varies between countries. Spain: rustic_rural, rustic_masia, rustic_cortijo, rustic_terrera, rustic_torre, rustic_caseron. Italy: house_villa, rustic_masseria, rustic_trullo, rustic_casalecascina, rustic_baita. Portugal: house_andar_moradia, rustic_quinta, rustic_moinho, rustic_montealentejano, rustic_solar. Spain and Portugal: rustic_palace. France: house_semidetached, house_independent, house_terraced, rustic_basque_house, rustic_contemporary_house, rustic_design_house, rustic_master_house, rustic_traditional_house, rustic_manor, rustic_riad, rustic_mazet, rustic_montain_chalet, rustic_vineyard_domain, rustic_farm, rustic_stone_house. The rest of the types is available in every country.

featuresDoorman.title: doorman
featuresDoorman.description: doorman availability. This field is deprecated and won't be used anymore in idealista

featuresLiftAvailable.description: available for flat, chalet and countryhouse types

title: Images Object
description: Formats allowed: JPG, GIF, PNG. Max number of images allowed: 200 per property. Max size of image allowed: 32MB

imageAiGenerated.title: AI generated image
imageAiGenerated.description: Indicates if the image was generated using AI. If not provided it will be automatically identified
